title: Keep ADRs Change-scoped until verified Archive promotion
context: Candidate and accepted implementation decisions should be visible during plan review without being mistaken for current Feature knowledge before delivery is verified.
decision: Draft structured ADRs inside Change Design, accept them at plan approval, and promote implemented copies to the narrowest Feature targets only during branch-local Archive. Preserve the original records in the frozen Change.

alternatives.option: Publish accepted ADRs directly into Features during Propose
alternatives.reason: Features would claim behavior as current before code and tests verify that it was delivered.
It would create another navigation and authority surface disconnected from Change review and Feature capability knowledge.

consequences: Every draft records hierarchical promotion targets before implementation.
Archive reconciles intended targets and decisions against actual delivery.
Later Changes supersede Feature copies without rewriting historical Change ADRs.
revisitTriggers: Decision volume makes Change and Feature rendering insufficient for cross-cutting discovery.
